footnote_text: The reported transaction reflects a same-day cashless exercise of stock options, in which the shares acquired upon exercise were sold on the open market. The Company received the exercise price and the Reporting Person received the net proceeds after applicable tax withholding. The price reported is the weighted average sale price; sales were made at prices ranging from $4.63 to $4.74. The Reporting Person undertakes to provide, upon request, full information regarding the number of shares sold at each separate price.
Represents shares acquired upon the exercise of stock options with an exercise price of $3.251 per share. The shares were sold on the same day in the open market, as reported on the following line.
